comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-04 ~02:00, gate at load ~20: detection::an_agent_waiting_on_its_own_work_has_not_finished timed out with the new detail 'it was None Unknown, reported: false, facts: None' - the fake agent was never identified at all. So the stall is in launching or identifying the agent, not a report landing before the wait is armed as guessed above. Passed 16/16 alone.

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-04 03:00, ruled out (from code): typed input lost (/bin/sh has no shell integration; readline uses TCSADRAIN); the first probe landing before exec with the acquisition window never opening (the agent's first paint lands on a later tick, whose screen change opens it); a dropped publication (publish_agent re-sends unsent every tick); pty/process limits (60/511 ptys, 544/2666 procs, $ prompt showed). 25 more runs at load 20-30 did not reproduce. Detection probes the foreground group on group change and in an 8 s acquisition window (500 ms for 1.5 s, then 2 s); after it, an unidentified pane is not probed until group or screen changes. Waits now print the pane's screen on timeout, so the next failure says whether the command ran.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
crates/muster-daemon/tests/daemon (detection module). Failed the full gate once on 2026-10-03 at load ~13 with three worktrees building: 'timed out after 20s waiting for p1 to be Some("claude") Idle, which never arrived'. Passes alone in 0.18s (3/3) and in 12 concurrent copies. A 20s wait for something that takes 0.18s suggests an ordering the test assumes rather than slowness - e.g. a state report or screen read that lands before the wait is armed under contention. Reproduce with the gate's own concurrency before changing anything (cf. a_2LTQZhuFV).

2026-10-03, later: not reproduced in 70 runs of the whole daemon test binary (27 with three loops at once at load 35-107, 43 beside other builds at load 15-60). 1,031 waits for p1 Idle: p50 94 ms, p95 232 ms, max 575 ms against a 20 s allowance. The wait now says what it saw instead when it times out (test: say what a detection wait saw instead), so the next failure names its cause.
title: 🎲 a_wait_outlasts_a_working_report_after_the_turn_that_declared_it timed out under load
